description.narrative: In February 2012, several countries formed with support of the United Nations Environmental Program (UNEP) a coalition called „ Climate and Clean Air Coalition to Reduce Short Lived Climate Pollutants“ (CCAC). Germany joined the initiative in June 2012. The goal of the coalition is to increase political awareness regarding the negative impact of short-lived climate pollutants on human health and the environment. Furthermore, the coalition aims to support initiatives to reduce the emission of short-lived climate pollutants. In this regard, capacity-building activities in developing countries is a particular objective. The project strenghtened the CCAC through an investment in the global fond and assisted the German Ministry for the Environment, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety, through the provision of additional human resources, in the participation and steering of this coalition.
